category: usenet provider (bundled newsreader, search and unlimited access)

free_tier.stated: A free 14-day trial is offered on all plans with up to 14GB TRIAL Usenet transfer.
free_tier.notes: The 14-day length and the 14 GB allowance are both on the first-party signup page.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; retrieval is by Usenet article over NNTP
per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

egress.terms: No speed limits and no download limits on the plans that include Usenet access

interface_detail: NNTP with 256-bit SSL; the vendor also ships its own client with SuperSearch and SuperLeech automation
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: Three plans: Pure Usenet is access only, Ready to Go adds the vendor newsreader and search, and Client Plus is software and search without access, so it adds nothing on its own to a retrieval path.
limits_note: Prices of the three plans are not on the pages read: unverified: behind a sign-up.
binding_note: No download, speed or volume limit is stated on the access plans; the cap on connections was not read.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the trial signup form was not opened, so the fields it asks for are behind a sign-up; a third-party index lists PayPal and card payments.

reliability_note: The home page carries news items dated 2022 and 2023 beside a 2026 copyright line; the status of support is unmeasured.
confidence_note: The trial offer, retention and absence of limits are from the vendor pages read on 2026-11-03 and 2026-11-25; prices are unverified.
